source.name: PR Newswire / Sandmark: Crypto News and Data Platform Sandmark Joins Artemis SailGP as Official Partner Ahead of 2026 Season
source.quote: Sandmark has joined Artemis SailGP as an Official Partner, supporting the Swedish team as it competes in SailGP's high-tech 50-foot foiling catamarans

source.name: SailGP team page - Artemis (Official Partners)
source.note: The team page renders its partner groups by script, so the quote can't be found by the checker; the embedded page data lists Artemis Technologies under the group 'Artemis Racing | Official Partners'.

source.name: Pelle P: Pelle P Appointed Official Clothing Supplier of Artemis SailGP
source.quote: The Swedish premium sailing brand Pelle P has been appointed Official Clothing Supplier of Artemis SailGP

summary: New Swedish team Artemis has no title partner; Sandmark (crypto news platform, joined as Official Partner January 2026), Artemis Technologies (Official Partner) and Pelle P (Official Clothing Supplier) are the commercial partners in the team page's partner block. Not marked complete: the same block lists the team's Purpose Partner, the Andrew Simpson Foundation, which is not recorded as a sponsor.
